verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered-agent evidence covers only a single generic mail flow: alerts for official mail, scanning and uploading, email reminders, a postcard and junk-mail filtering. Nothing documents service of process being handled separately from ordinary mail or carrying distinct delivery commitments. A generic mail-handling flow is an adjacent feature and does not satisfy this story.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider documents how service of legal papers is handled separately from ordinary mail, with distinct delivery commitments
